name: LP 544-12

boundTo.source: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list GJ 3473 and LP 544-12 in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 3094290054327367168 and 3094290019967631360), 1,346 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 4.1e-6: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.

description: Star bound to GJ 3473, 1,346 AU away.

radius.source: Stassun et al. (2019), AJ 158, 138 (TIC v8.2), the radius of TIC 452866792 (VizieR IV/39/tic82)

text.card: LP 544-12 is a star of 2,832 K, bound to GJ 3473 1,346 AU away.
text.introduction: LP 544-12 shares its motion through space with GJ 3473, 1,346 AU away, so the two are a bound pair. Both are placed where Gaia measures them.

notes: LP 544-12's orbit around GJ 3473 is not measured; both stars are placed at their Gaia DR3 positions, which is where they are

radialVelocity.source: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 3094290019967631360 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 9,000 of its distance per century
